accepted_plan.summary: Implement separate `host_api.websocket` Plugin capability with manifest WebSocket target declarations, enablement grants, static inspection/CLI diagnostics, host-owned bounded connection handles, runtime allow/deny policy, request API continued WebSocket rejection, docs/WIT/API updates, and focused tests.
accepted_plan.role_plan: Orchestrator creates a dedicated child worktree and spawns a narrow-scope Coder. Reviewer will be spawned read-only after Coder reports implementation commit(s). After approval, Orchestrator integrates into `orchestration`, validates plugin manifest/runtime/CLI/docs tests and Nix if dependency changes occur, records closure, and cleans only the child worktree/branch.
